description: Returns the characters from the middle of a text string, given a starting position and length.

params.description: The text string from which to extract the characters.
params.name: arg1

params.description: The position of the first character to extract. The first text character is 1.
params.name: arg2

params.description: A number of the characters to extract.
params.name: arg3

signature: MID(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | string, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg3: ApiRange | ApiName | number): string
